title: 第11章 为师一生不弱於人第12章 悟性逆天的徒弟练气四重
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 楚风站在床前。
看著床上萧火火又是咬牙切齿，又是神情变换的模样，他便是明白，他所做的敲打又成功了！
这小子定是在脑补！
没过一会，从思索中回过神来的萧火火犹豫了一番，还是昂首问道：
“师尊，火火想知道，您当年纳气入体的时候，纳了多少道灵气？”
说著，少年的眼中闪著些许期待的神色。
师尊的实力高深莫测，想来，定是不会比那些个天才差的吧？
说不定，也会有八道灵气入体，甚至是传说中九道灵气入体，一日链气的超级天才！
来了！
楚风早就料到了，这个喜欢脑补的小子肯定会忍不住去问他当年如何。
也不枉费他前面这么多口舌，编造出了一茬又一茬的东西。
现在是派上了用场！
楚风依旧是一副超然物外，高深莫测的模样：
“为师一生，不与人弱！”
话音落下，其身上恐怖的气息当即扩散了开来。
却见十道霞光，在屋內左右流转，形成光轮一般的模样，似那满月，又似那烈日，盈满无比！
本只能靠灯火撑著微弱光亮的茅房，立即变得比白天还要明亮刺目。
萧火火一震，惊嘆的瞪大眼睛看向左右。
看向霞光飘荡，游走，那神跡般的画面。
他不禁喃喃自语道：
“上古妖孽都才九道灵气衝破极限迈入链气，而师尊居然是来到了十道，这圆满之数！”
“一生不与人弱……却是远超了任何一人。”

“师尊比我想像中的，还是要强上太多。”
“一定是万年不出的超级强者！”
霞光在几番轮转后，便是回落在了楚风的身体之上，被收回了体內。
而萧火火也是自然的明了，暗自感动的道：
“师尊一定是为了我能直观的体会到纳灵入体圆满之境的好处，才刻意使用手段將修为压缩，直至纳灵入体显化。”
“师尊真是用心良苦，我一定不能辜负师尊的期望。”
旋即，他仍旧是激动的道：
“师尊居然超过了纳灵入体的极限之术，那师尊迈入链气期……”
楚风嘴角掛著一丝笑意：

Chu Feng stood in front of the bed.
Seeing Xiao Huohuo gnashing his teeth and changing his expression on the bed, he knew that the beating he had done was successful again!
This guy must be thinking!
After a while, Xiao Huohuo, who came back from his thoughts, hesitated for a while, then raised his head and asked:
"Master, Huohuo wants to know, how many spiritual energy did you absorb when you absorbed the energy into your body?"
As he said that, the young man's eyes flashed with a look of expectation.
Master's strength is unpredictable. Thinking about it, he must be no worse than those geniuses, right?
Maybe, there will also be eight spiritual qi entering the body, or even the legendary nine spiritual qi entering the body, a super genius who can chain qi in a day!
Coming!
Chu Feng had already expected that this kid who likes to think about things would definitely not be able to help but ask him how he was doing back then.
It's not like he wasted so much time and made up one thing after another.
Now it comes in handy!
Chu Feng still looked aloof and enigmatic:
"As a teacher, I will never be weak to others!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the terrifying aura on his body immediately spread.
But I saw ten rays of rays of light flowing left and right in the house, forming a halo-like appearance, like the full moon, and like the scorching sun, extremely full!
The hut, which could only rely on lights to provide weak light, immediately became brighter and dazzling than during the day.
Xiao Huohuo was shocked and looked to the left and right with wide eyes in wonder.
Look at the miraculous scene of the glow floating and wandering away.
He couldn't help but murmured to himself:
"The ancient evildoers only had nine spiritual qi to break through the limit and step into the chain qi, but the master actually came to the tenth, such a perfect number!"
"I have never been weak to anyone in my life...but I am far superior to anyone."

"Master is much stronger than I thought."
"He must be a super strong man who will never appear in ten thousand years!"
After several turns, the glow fell back on Chu Feng's body and was taken back into the body.
And Xiao Huohuo was naturally understanding and said secretly:
"Master must have deliberately used methods to compress my cultivation level until I could intuitively appreciate the benefits of incorporating the spirit into the body."
"Master is really well-intentioned. I must not let down Master's expectations."
Immediately, he still said excitedly:
"Master actually surpassed the limit of the ability to absorb spirits into the body. Then Master has entered the Qi Chain stage..."
There was a smile on Chu Feng's lips:
